items.claim: Removing a joint unbinds node bindings
items.note: `bone.remove` cleaned up skins but left `data.joint` naming the removed joints. It now clears those in the same undo entry, so the next bone drawn under a reused name doesn't take those nodes over. I cleared the binding rather than rebinding the node to the parent joint; that matches how skins drop a removed joint's weights.

items.claim: Weight brush leaves gaps on a fast drag
items.note: `brushWeights` (animator) takes an optional `from` point and weighs each point by its distance to the segment from there. `weight.paint` passes the previous pointer sample, so the swath is continuous. This carries two changesets: a rig patch fix and an animator minor api.

items.claim: Overlays don't repaint when an outside `selection` or `rig` thunk changes
items.note: `useRigTools`, `useBoneTool` and `useWeightTool` take a `subscribe` option, and it reaches every overlay layer. This adds API, so its changeset is minor api.
